name: Legions to Ashes
oracle_text: Exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls and all tokens that player controls with the same name as that permanent.
blocked_sentences: Exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls and all tokens that player controls with the same name as that permanent.

needs.what: a selector clause that matches objects whose name equals the name of another object bound in the same effect -- e.g. {"is_token": true, "controller": {"controller_of_target": 0}, "shares_a_name_with": "target", "count": "all"} -- so a spell can sweep every copy of the thing it targeted
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `name` selector key is a literal string compared against card.name, so it can only be written by the card author at load time and cannot read the name of the target chosen at cast time. The two binding-reading clauses that do exist, `shares_a_type_with` and `shares_a_color_with`, compare subtypes and colors off a bound oid but there is no name-comparing sibling. `snapshot` only captures a numeric value off a departing object, not a name usable as a selector filter.
